title: pipeline verify_article runs over original_bytes not post-Path bytes — correct design
description: transit pipeline.rs snapshots original_bytes before calling prepend_path_header, and runs verify_article over original_bytes. The CID (IPFS block) is computed from post-Path bytes. This is the right tradeoff: X-Stoa-Sig is computed by the originating peer before transit hops, so verification must use the pre-hop bytes. The code comment at DESIGN NOTE rbe3.46 correctly explains why CID and verification bytes differ, and that this is intentional. A contributor might try to 'fix' this by verifying over the stored block bytes, which would produce systematic false-negatives. Worth defending.
